#define utstring_concat(dst,src)                                 \
do {                                                             \
  utstring_reserve((dst),((src)->i)+1);                          \
  if ((src)->i) memcpy(&(dst)->d[(dst)->i], (src)->d, (src)->i); \
  (dst)->i += (src)->i;                                          \
  (dst)->d[(dst)->i]='\0';                                       \
} while(0)
